findings.desc: quality-cleanup: done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts:174 — non-null assertion cache! is unsound (TypeScript cannot infer process.exit(1) as noreturn, so cache remains FindingSignalsCache|null at this point) and the as-number cast that follows is redundant (typeof cache?.coveredFindingCount === 'number' already narrows it). Fix: pull the null guard into a real branch before this line (e.g. if (!cache) { ... return; }), then drop both the non-null assertion and the cast.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 94f529ec6; smoke null-guard replaces unsound cache! assertion + redundant cast. Confirmed by round-3 quality lane.

findings.desc: quality-cleanup: learning-validate.ts:129+146 — coverage gap comparison is scoped incorrectly when args.story filter is active. deriveFindingSignalsFromStore is called with { storyIds } (single-story subset), so cache.coveredFindingCount/.coveredStoryCount reflect only that one story. But readFindingSignals(cwd) on line 145 reads the FULL persisted cache (all stories). computeCoverageGap then compares partial current counts against a full persisted watermark, producing a confusing/misleading gap line (e.g. persisted=50 findings, derived=3 for one story => gap shows 0 because max(3-50,0)=0 — a false in-sync signal). Fix: skip the coverage gap report (or emit 'coverage: n/a (filtered view)') when storyIds filter is active.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 94f529ec6; learning-validate filtered-view suppresses misleading subset-vs-global gap. Confirmed by codex r2/r3 repro + concept r3.

findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 — applyDoneMergeEffects passes no `now` to deriveFindingSignalsFromStore so the written cache always has updatedAt=\"1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z\" (epoch) instead of the current wall-clock time. The intent says \"updatedAt advances\"; the implementation regresses it. The smoke (assertHappyRefreshesCacheOnMain) never asserts cache.updatedAt, so this bug passes all 15 checks undetected. Fix: add `now: new Date().toISOString()` to the deriveFindingSignalsFromStore opts at done-effects.ts line 927. Add a smoke assertion: assert cache.updatedAt > \"2020-01-01\" (or similar recent floor).
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 94f529ec6; done-effects passes now:new Date().toISOString() so updatedAt is wall-clock not epoch; smoke asserts not-epoch. Confirmed by test-coverage r2/r3.

findings.desc: CHK-001:edge:0 — the intent is \"refresh runs on EVERY DONE merge, not gated on material-code change\". The smoke only drives one scenario where a material code file (packages/main/src/app.ts) IS committed. There is no scenario where the story branch carries ONLY metadata changes (no code file, no build predicate hit) and the refresh still fires. Without this second scenario the edge case is asserted by the evidence note alone, not by an executable assertion. The implementation is correct (the refresh block at done-effects.ts:925-932 is not inside any shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths guard) but the smoke does not prove it. Fix: add a second control scenario to done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts where the story branch commits only story metadata (no packages/main/ code changes) and assert the advisory \"experience cache refreshed\" line still appears.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in 94f529ec6; metadata-only merge smoke scenario asserts build SKIPPED yet refresh still fires. Confirmed by test-coverage r2/r3.

findings.desc: storyIds-filter-coverage-gap-silent-false-negative: when `learning_validate --story=B-xxx` is called with a story filter, the derived `cache.coveredFindingCount` reflects only the filtered subset (e.g. 2 findings from 1 story), while the persisted cache covers the full corpus (e.g. 438 findings). computeCoverageGap computes gapFindings = max(2 - 438, 0) = 0, so the coverage line reads "0 gap" even when the persisted cache is seriously stale. This is a silent false-negative: --story-filtered learning_validate can never report a non-zero coverage gap regardless of cache freshness. The behavior is not documented. Fix: skip the coverage gap line (or suppress it with a note) when storyIds filter is active, so a filtered run never claims "0 gap" for a potentially stale full-corpus cache.

quality-cleanup: done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts:172,241 use m![1] non-null assertion inside `!!m &&` — TypeScript already narrows m to RegExpMatchArray when !!m is truthy, so the `!` is superfluous (same assertion class as original F-001). Replace with m[1] to remove the unnecessary non-null assertion.

quality-cleanup: done-merge-experience-refresh-smoke.ts:187,250 — dead assertions: `check(... cache !== null ...)` is always true because the preceding `if (cache === null) { process.exit(1) }` at lines 183-186 and 246-249 already guarantees cache is non-null. These check() calls can never fail and should be removed to eliminate unreachable dead code.

CHK-003:edge filtered-view branch lacks a load-bearing assertion: learning-validate.ts:154-162 adds a new filtered branch that returns coverage:{filtered:true} (JSON) and the human line "coverage: n/a (filtered view...)" when --story is active. experience-layer-revalidation-cli-smoke.ts lines 115-119 exercise this path but only assert typeof report.total === number — the new coverage.filtered field is never asserted. A regression that erroneously emits a numeric gap on the filtered path instead (e.g., reverts the filtered branch) would pass the existing check undetected. Add an assertion: assert.equal(report.coverage?.filtered, true) for the JSON path and/or assert the human output contains the n/a advisory string.
